We’re looking for an experienced Operations Coordinator to help oversee the workflows that support our customers from onboarding onward.

This is a hands-on role focused on keeping customers successful, coordinating across teams, improving processes, and making sure issues and commitments don’t fall through the cracks. This is not an executive or strategy-only position.

What You’ll Do

  • Coordinate the customer journey from onboarding and training through ongoing support and retention.
  • Follow up with customers, identify pain points, and make sure issues are carried through to resolution.
  • Coordinate issues involving Sales, Accounting, Software, integrations, or licensing, bringing the right people together and keeping ownership clear.
  • Build and improve business processes rather than simply following existing ones.
  • Keep projects and priorities moving by tracking commitments, dependencies, blockers, and next steps.
  • Spot gaps and blind spots, ask the right questions, and identify who needs to be involved.
  • Use customer feedback and operational information to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Provide clear, concise updates and help keep operations organized end-to-end.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience in operations, project coordination, project management, customer operations, or a similar hands-on role.
  • Experience owning projects or operational work through completion, including coordinating dependencies and following up on outstanding items.
  • Comfortable working from an initial goal, identifying what information or people are needed, and building a practical plan.
  • Experience coordinating across different teams and priorities.
  • Clear, concise professional communication.
  • Interested in a stable, long-term, hands-on coordination role.

Benefits

  • CAD $80,000 annual salary plus up to CAD $10,000 annual bonus
  • Fully remote

Originally posted on Himalayas
